title: HQ reversion: h1 bx (H1 pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week with high-quality, high-probability, high-profit setups - mean reversion at exhaustion (stretched range / both sides swept / stretched into a HTF pool / failed ORB).
verdict: $500 risk, costs in. H1: 25 trades (0.98/wk), true win 56.0%, PF 1.79, net +4,152 ($681/mo), DD -974. H2: 18 trades (1.15/wk), true win 38.9%, PF 0.91, net -492 ($-132/mo), DD -2,855. 2025: 69 trades (1.34/wk), true win 33.3%, PF 0.73, net -5,887 ($-479/mo), DD -9,783. 2021-24: 225 trades (1.38/wk), true win 37.8%, PF 0.85, net -10,359 ($-267/mo), DD -13,033. Evals (pass/fail-or-dead %): H1 25K alone 2-wk 7.6/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 56.3/5.9; H2 25K alone 2-wk 7.2/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 47.8/5.8; 2025 25K alone 2-wk 4.4/0.8, next to LIT on the 50K 13.3/2.0; 2021-24 25K alone 2-wk 4.5/5.1, next to LIT on the 50K 13.9/10.7.
notes: tools/hq_revert.py; H1 pick (2026 Jan-Jun, 20+ trades, true winners >= 55%, avg winner >= 1R, PF >= 1.3, plateau score)

rules: Box swept: the London 02:00-05:00 range; its high AND its low have both been traded through since the box closed; the second sweep; within 3 bars a 5m close back inside that is also beyond the open of the candle run into the extreme (CISD); entries until 12:00 ET.
Trade against the swept side (short after a high, long after a low) at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop 1 tick beyond the extreme from the sweep to the signal bar (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Time exit 15:55 ET; one trade a day; $500 risk (floor(500 / (stop x $2)) micros, max 50); $1.90 a micro + 1 tick on entries, stop and time exits.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
